item.title: Hazleton Area High School mock trial team wins district championship, advances to regionals
item.description: The Hazleton Area High School mock trial team earned the district championship after an undefeated run.

item.title: House narrowly rejects Iran war powers resolution in early test of Trump’s strategy
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The House narrowly rejected a war powers resolution Thursday to halt President Donald Trump’s attacks on Iran, an early sign of unease in Congress over the rapidly widening conflict that is reordering U.S. priorities at home and abroad.

item.title: Celtics’ Tatum listed as ‘questionable,’ on verge of return 9 months after Achilles surgery
item.description: BOSTON — Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum is on the verge of making a return to NBA action nine months after rupturing his right Achilles tendon injury during last season’s playoffs.

item.title: Penn State fires women’s basketball coach Carolyn Kieger after 7 seasons
item.description: STATE COLLEGE — Penn State fired women’s basketball coach Carolyn Kieger on Thursday after seven seasons.

item.title: Luzerne County updates residents on proposed data center zoning amendment
item.description: Luzerne County’s GIS, Planning, and Zoning Department updated residents on Thursday on its proposed county zoning ordinance amendment regulating data centers.

item.title: Five WVC wresters advance to state quarterfinals
item.description: Five Wyoming Valley Conference wrestlers are still alive in the hunt for a state title after the opening day of the PIAA Wrestling Championships on Thursday at the Giant Center in Hershey.

item.title: H.S. Basketball: Seven Wyoming Valley Conference teams begin state trek
item.description: The Wyoming Valley Conference entered the District 2 basketball championships with seven chances for titles.

item.title: Hazleton Area holds town hall on upcoming Freeland Elementary/Middle School renovations
item.description: The Hazleton Area School District Board of Education held a public town hall Thursday to discuss an upcoming renovation project at Freeland Elementary/Middle School.
